blocks.text: Enzymes ki darja-bandi (classification) do tarah se ki jati hai: un reactions ki bunyad par jo woh catalyse karte hain, aur un substrates ki bunyad par jin par woh kaam karte hain.
Reaction ki aam qisam ke lihaz se enzymes chhe classes mein baante gaye hain.

items: Oxidoreductases: yeh enzymes apne substrates ka oxidation ya reduction karwate hain. Yeh substrates mein H⁺ ions ya electrons shamil karte ya un se nikalte hain. Maslan cytochrome oxidase cytochrome ka oxidation karwata hai.

Transferases: is class ke enzymes ek khaas functional group (maslan methyl, acyl, amino ya phosphate) ko ek substrate se doosre substrate tak muntaqil (transfer) karte hain. Maslan hexokinase ATP se phosphate group le kar glucose ko deta hai.

Hydrolases: yeh enzymes hydrolysis reactions karwate hain, yani pani mila kar apne substrates ko monomers (chhoti ikaiyon) mein torte hain. Maslan lipase, amylase, peptidase aur doosre digestive (hazme ke) enzymes khuraak ke molecules ki hydrolysis karte hain.
Lyases: yeh enzymes pani ke baghair (non-hydrolytic) substrates mein groups (maslan CO₂, NH₂) shamil karte ya un se nikalte hain. Maslan pyruvate decarboxylase pyruvic acid se CO₂ nikalta hai.

Isomerases: yeh enzymes molecule ke andar atoms ki nayi tarteeb (intra-molecular rearrangement) karte hain, yani ek isomer ko doosre isomer mein badalte hain. Maslan hexose isomerase glucose ko fructose mein badalta hai.

Ligases: yeh enzymes un reactions ko karwate hain jin mein do molecules naye C-C, C-N, C-O ya C-S bonds bana kar jurte hain, aur is ke liye ATP ki tawanai lagti hai. Kitab ki misal: polymerase enzymes ATP istemal kar ke monomers jorte hain.

blocks.text: Enzymes ko un ke substrates ki bunyad par bhi in groups mein baanta jata hai.

items: Proteases: is group mein woh enzymes hain jo proteins ko torte hain. Maslan pepsin aur trypsin bare polypeptides ko chhote polypeptides mein torte hain. Isi tarah aminopeptidases chhote polypeptides ko dipeptides mein, aur erepsin dipeptides ko amino acids mein torta hai.
Lipases: yeh enzymes lipids (charbi) par kaam karte hain aur unhein torte hain. Maslan pancreatic lipase lipids ko fatty acids aur glycerol mein torta (hydrolyse karta) hai.

Carbohydrases: yeh enzymes bare carbohydrates ko chhoti ikaiyon mein torte hain. Maslan amylase starch ya glycogen ko maltose mein torta hai. Cellulase cellulose ko cellobiose (ek disaccharide) ya glucose mein torta hai. Isi tarah maltase maltose ko glucose mein, sucrase sucrose ko glucose aur fructose mein, aur lactase lactose ko glucose aur galactose mein torta hai.
Nucleases: yeh enzymes nucleic acids par kaam karte hain aur unhein torte hain. Kitab ki misalein: RNAase, DNAase aur ATPase bil-tarteeb (respectively) RNA, DNA aur ATP ko torte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “erypsin” chhapa hai; is enzyme ka sahi naam erepsin hai (yeh dipeptides ko amino acids mein torta hai).

blocks.alt: Teen columns (Class, Reaction type, Important subclasses) aur chhe qataron wala table; har reaction harf wali gendon aur do-taraf (reversible) teeron se bana hai. 1 Oxidoreductases: A (red) do hydrogen ke saath + B (ox) se A (ox) + B (red); dehydrogenases, oxidases, reductases. 2 Transferases: A-B + C se A + C-B; phospho-, amino- aur acyl-transferases. 3 Hydrolases: A-B + H2O se C + D; peptidases, lipases, glycosidases.

blocks.long_description: Teen columns (Class, Reaction type, Important subclasses) aur chhe qataron wala table; har reaction harf wali gendon aur do-taraf (reversible) teeron se bana hai. 1 Oxidoreductases: A (red) do hydrogen ke saath + B (ox) se A (ox) + B (red); dehydrogenases, oxidases, reductases. 2 Transferases: A-B + C se A + C-B; phospho-, amino- aur acyl-transferases. 3 Hydrolases: A-B + H2O se C + D; peptidases, lipases, glycosidases. 4 Lyases: chhote group wala A se C + group; decarboxylases, aldolases, synthases. 5 Isomerases: A se A jis ka ek hissa jagah badalta hai; epimerases, mutases, cis trans isomerases. 6 Ligases: A + B + ATP se A-B + ADP + phosphate; C-C, C-O, C-N ligases.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har qatar mein dekhein kya badalta hai: 1 mein hydrogen (do safed gendein) A se B par jati hai, yani A oxidise aur B reduce hota hai; 2 mein B ek molecule se doosre par muntaqil hota hai; 3 mein paani A-B ko tor deta hai; 4 mein ek chhota group (maslan CO₂) bina paani ke alag hota hai; 5 mein atoms wahi rehte hain, sirf tarteeb badalti hai; 6 mein ATP ki tawanai se A aur B jurte hain aur ATP, ADP ban jata hai.

blocks.text: Kitab ke chhape hue table mein teesri class 'Hydrases' aur ek subclass 'Glycodsidases' likhi hai; durust naam Hydrolases aur Glycosidases hain, jo yahan likhe gaye hain.

blocks.prompt: Har enzyme ko us ki reaction class mein rakhein: hexokinase, lipase, pyruvate decarboxylase, cytochrome oxidase, hexose isomerase. Phir batayein ke lipase aur amylase substrate ke lihaz se kis group mein hain.
blocks.explanation: Hexokinase: transferase (ATP se glucose ko phosphate group deta hai). Lipase: hydrolase (pani mila kar torta hai). Pyruvate decarboxylase: lyase (pyruvic acid se CO₂ nikalta hai). Cytochrome oxidase: oxidoreductase. Hexose isomerase: isomerase (glucose ko fructose banata hai). Substrate ke lihaz se lipase lipases ke group mein hai (lipids torta hai) aur amylase carbohydrases ke group mein (starch aur glycogen ko maltose banata hai).

items: Reaction ke lihaz se chhe classes: oxidoreductases (cytochrome oxidase), transferases (hexokinase), hydrolases (hazme ke enzymes), lyases (pyruvate decarboxylase), isomerases (hexose isomerase), ligases (ATP ki tawanai se do molecules jorne wale).
Substrate ke lihaz se: proteases (pepsin, trypsin, aminopeptidases, erepsin), lipases (pancreatic lipase), carbohydrases (amylase, cellulase, maltase, sucrase, lactase), nucleases (RNAase, DNAase).
